shellCommands.command: git status --short && cat package.json && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | head -100
git diff package.json; for f in next.config.ts tsconfig.json lib/data.ts app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx app/product/page.tsx __agent_eval__/run.mjs; do echo "=== $f ==="; cat "$f"; done

ls node_modules/next 2>/dev/null | head; cat node_modules/next/package.json 2>/dev/null | grep '"version"'; grep -rn "unstable_prefetch\|prefetch=\"unstable\|unstable_forceStale\|prefetch: 'auto'\|\"cacheLife\"\|prefetchExclude\|'unstable_include'\|unstable_exclude" node_modules/next/dist/client/app-dir/link.d.ts node_modules/next/dist/server/app-render/*.d.ts node_modules/next/types/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -40
cd node_modules/next && cat AGENTS.md | head -150; echo ====; cat cache.d.ts; echo ====; grep -rn "prefetch" dist/client/app-dir/link.d.ts | head -30

cd node_modules/next && cat dist/server/request/cache-stages.d.ts; echo ====; grep -rln "unstable_prefetch\|cache-stages\|Cache Stages\|cache stages" dist/docs | head; echo ====; sed -n 85,140p dist/client/app-dir/link.d.ts

cat dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/prefetch.md; echo; echo "==== NAVIGATION ===="; cat dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/navigation.md; echo; echo "==== cache-stages.d.ts ===="; cat dist/server/request/cache-stages.d.ts

cat dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/05-config/01-next-config-js/partialPrefetching.md 2>/dev/null || find dist/docs -name '*artialPrefetching*' -o -name '*partial-prefetching*'; echo ====; cat dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/adopting-partial-prefetching.md 2>/dev/null | head -200
grep -n -A60 "## Exclude content from a prefetch\|## Exclude cached content" dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/optimizing-prefetching.md | head -120
cd /workspace && npx tsc --noEmit -p . 2>&1 | tail -20; echo "tsc exit: $?"; npx next build 2>&1 | tail -40
git checkout -- tsconfig.json && rm -rf .next next-env.d.ts tsconfig.tsbuildinfo && cat .gitignore && git status --short && git diff -- app next.config.ts
